definition: All mapped national river reaches, with upper-left Q2 profiles retained and remaining reaches scaled by routed headwater contribution.
coordinate_reference: input_map.png image pixels; origin at upper left
width_semantics: Display-only widths in source image pixels. Q2 keeps its reviewed profiles; other reaches scale with upstream sources, lowland elevation, and downstream reach length; confluences combine tributary widths quadratically. No width is a literal surveyed kilometre value.

national_width_method.outlet_rule: Each endpoint tree is rooted at its lowest mapped water surface, with coast or lake proximity resolving near-equal elevations.
national_width_method.confluence_rule: Downstream width is at least the square root of the summed squared upstream reach widths.
national_width_method.plain_meander_selection: One long, comparatively straight reach per basin when both banks remain below 500m with less than 500m relief spread.
